definitions: Establish (an attitude, habit, or belief) so firmly that it is difficult to change.
Establish (a military force, position, or way of life) firmly and securely.
Surround (a place) with a trench or trenches as a defence.
examples: The government's policy is to entrench free-market principles.
The troops entrenched themselves on the hill.
They entrenched the camp against enemy attack.
